fights.notes: Duration is garbled in the OCR (srxiecco minutes amd twent) fve seconds); 16 min 25 sec is a low-confidence reading. Date is not in this article; taken from the 1877-11-21 account (London Sporting Life of Oct 31). Gilbert would not come back after the seventh round.

notes: Report from the London Sportsman. The paper's remark that Allen's condition was not the best is paraphrase, not Allen's words, so it is not recorded.
